narr: A highly unstable and moist atmosphere promoted heavy rainfall over portions of west central and northeast Georgia as several disturbances traversed a stalled frontal boundary. Several reports of flash flooding were relayed in the early morning hours as rainfall amounts of 3 to 6 inches fell quickly over west central Georgia.
ev: The Emergency Manager reported the bridge on Wallace Road between Robert Williams Road and Chipley Highway was flooded from a nearby lake. Radar estimates indicate that between 3 and 4 inches of rain occurred quickly over the area during the overnight period, resulting in the flash flooding.
The Emergency Manager reported Mobley Road washed out at Little Branch. Radar estimates indicate that between 3 and 5 inches of rain occurred over the area, resulting in the flash flooding.
lsr: THE BRIDGE ON WALLACE ROAD BETWEEN ROBERT WILLIAMS ROAD AND CHIPLEY HIGHWAY WAS FLOODED AND CLOSED.
MOBLEY ROAD WAS WASHED OUT AT LITTLE BRANCH.
